about.title: Oinkly
about.subtitle: Your path to financial freedom
about.methodDescription: Pay off your smallest debt first. Build momentum. Win faster. Your debts auto-organize from smallest to largest—focus on one while paying minimums on others.
about.step1Description: Capture what you know about each debt. Don't stress about perfection—clarity beats accuracy.
about.step2Description: See which debt to tackle first. The app sorts automatically—your path forward is clear.
about.step3Description: Stay in touch. Record every call. Track every commitment. Never miss a detail.
about.step4Description: Complete commitments. Update balances. Watch your plan evolve with each payment.
about.step5Description: See your progress. Your plan adapts automatically. The path to debt-free is always clear.
about.tip1Description: Update balances after payments. Accurate info = better decisions.
about.tip2Description: Every bank agreement goes in the app. Stay organized. Never miss a payment.
about.tip3Description: Every conversation matters. Date, discussion, agreements. Build your communication history.
about.tip4Description: See how far you've come. Visual progress keeps you motivated and committed.
about.philosophy1Description: Debt management shouldn't be complicated. We focus on what matters: organize, track, communicate.
about.philosophy2Description: Be proactive. Stay informed. Track every agreement. Oinkly helps you stay in control.
about.philosophy3Description: See where you are. See where you're going. Progress becomes tangible. Motivation stays strong.

terms.serviceDescriptionText: Oinkly is a personal finance management application designed to help you track and manage your debts, payment commitments, and financial obligations. The application provides tools for organizing debt information, scheduling payments, and monitoring your financial status.

terms.terminationText: You may stop using the application at any time. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your access to the application at our sole discretion, without notice, for conduct that we believe violates these terms or is harmful to other users, us, or third parties.
terms.informationCollectionText: Oinkly collects and stores the following types of information to provide you with our services:
terms.collectedInfo1: Personal identification information (name, email address) that you provide during registration.
terms.collectedInfo2: Financial data including debt information, payment commitments, bank details, and transaction records that you enter into the application.
terms.collectedInfo3: Usage data such as your preferences, settings, and application activity.
terms.collectedInfo4: Device information and technical data necessary for the application to function properly.
terms.dataStorageText: All data entered into the Oinkly application is stored locally on your device using browser local storage. We do not transmit, store, or have access to your financial data on external servers. Your data remains under your complete control and is stored only on the device you use to access the application.
terms.dataUsageText: The information you provide is used solely for the following purposes:
terms.usagePurpose1: To provide and maintain the Oinkly application's functionality.
terms.usagePurpose2: To personalize your experience and remember your preferences.
terms.usagePurpose3: To improve the application's features and user experience.
terms.dataSharingText: We do not share, sell, rent, or trade your personal or financial information with third parties. Since all data is stored locally on your device, we have no access to your information and therefore cannot share it. Your financial data remains private and secure on your device.
terms.dataSecurityText: We implement appropriate technical measures to protect your data stored locally on your device. However, you are responsible for maintaining the security of your device and ensuring that unauthorized persons do not have access to it. We recommend using device security features such as passwords, biometric authentication, and keeping your device's operating system updated.
terms.userRightsText: You have the following rights regarding your data:
terms.right1: Access: You can view all your data directly within the application.
terms.right2: Modification: You can edit, update, or delete any information you have entered at any time.
terms.right3: Deletion: You can delete your data by clearing your browser's local storage or uninstalling the application.
terms.right4: Export: You can export your data if such functionality is provided in the application.
terms.cookiesText: Oinkly uses browser local storage to store your application data and preferences. This is necessary for the application to function properly. No cookies are used for tracking or advertising purposes.
terms.childrenPrivacyText: Oinkly is not intended for use by individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us immediately.
terms.contactText: If you have any questions about these Terms and Conditions or Privacy Policy, please contact us through the application's support channels or your preferred method of communication.
